title: Purity of the Artin–Schreier sheaf
statement:
Let $k_0=\mathbf F_q$ and fix the nondegenerate additive character
$\psi$ of [def-fd-additive-character]. Let $a\in k_0^\times$ and fix
$\iota:\Qlb\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf C$ as in
[def-weil-punctual-weights]. The Artin–Schreier sheaf
$\mathcal L_{\psi,ax}$ on $\mathbf A^1_{k_0}$, as defined in
[def-fd-artin-schreier-sheaf], is punctually
$\iota$-pure of weight $0$.

proof.text: By [lem-fd-as-lisse], the sheaf $\mathcal L_{\psi,ax}$ is lisse of rank one, so at every closed point $u$ its unique local Frobenius eigenvalue is the trace value $t_{\mathcal L_{\psi,ax}}(u)$ of [lem-fd-as-trace], namely $\psi(\operatorname{Tr}_{\kappa(u)/k_0}(au))$. The trace lies in the finite additive group $k_0$, so the homomorphism property of the additive character gives $\psi(\operatorname{Tr}_{\kappa(u)/k_0}(au))^{q}=1$; it is therefore a root of unity. By [lem-tw-root-of-unity-modulus], its image under $\iota$ has modulus one. Hence every local eigenvalue $\alpha$ satisfies $|\iota(\alpha)|=1=q_u^{0/2}$, which is precisely punctual $\iota$-purity of weight $0$ by [def-weil-punctual-weights].

lean.statement:
theorem isPunctuallyPureOfWeight_artinSchreier (ι : PadicAlgCl l →+* ℂ)
    (ψ : AddChar k₀ (PadicAlgCl l)) (a : k₀) :
    (artinSchreier ψ a).IsPunctuallyPureOfWeight ι 0
lean.note: Existing upstream purity theorem for the canonical adic Weil Artin–Schreier sheaf. Specialize the character to the fixed nondegenerate trace character, a to the value of the specified unit, and ι to iota.toRingHom. The theorem is valid for all characters and scalars; this records the existing theorem rather than strengthening the DAG statement. Its punctual predicate is the upstream adic Weil-heart encoding of the same closed-point eigenvalue condition; the newer Sf predicate uses the common-stage heart, with the comparison left to stage 3.
